blocks.text: GLOSSARY

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: This glossary of annelid terminology is edited and shortened of that an version written by Glasby et al. (2000) and Rouse and Pleije} (2001).

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: abdomen: body region posterior the thorax. to Varies among annelid and should be generally groups not regarded as indi- cating homologous regions.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: abranchial: without branchiae.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: abyssal: oceanic waters between depths of 4000 m and 6000 m. achaetous: without chaetac.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: acicula, aciculae: stout supportive chaeta found internally in projecting parapodial rami.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: acicular chaeta: stout, projecting chaeta.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: acrosome: membrane limited organelle of at apex sperma- tozoon head, covering the anterior surface of the nucleus; secretes enzymes thought facilitate to sperm entry.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: adelphophagy: consumption by a developing larva of nurse eggs present in the same egg capsule.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: aileron: accessory jaw plate in Glyceridae.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: aliform: elongate narrow lobe, used to refer pair of to a notopo- dia of some Chaetopteridae.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: anal plaque: depressed (or sunken) plate-like pygidium of some Maldanidae and other annelids.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: anal paired sacs: posterior evaginations from the hindgut in Thalassematidae, possibly homologous with metanephridia.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: androecium: small cavity within the metanephridial of sac Bonelliinae, where the dwarf males often found, are

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: annulated: ringed or marked with grooves delineating seg- ments.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: antenna, antennae: sensory projection arising from the dorsal, lateral, or frontal surface of the prostomium.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: antennular auricle: auricule. see

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: anterior cirri: dorsal and/or ventral cirti of parapodia of cephalized segments; often more elongate than those of more posterior parapodia; confused in the literature with peristomi- al cirri, (See tentacular cirri).

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: anterior cirri formula: notation indicating the arrangement of the anterior cirri and chaetae; originally used for Phyllodocidae, now also extended to other Phyllodocida.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: apical tooth: primary tooth. see

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: apodous: segments without parapodia.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: apomorphy: a derived, or less general state; see synapomorphy and compare with plesiomorphy.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: arborescent: branching like a tree.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: aristate chaeta: simple chaeta with smooth shaft and tuft of a hairs or a single spine.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: architomy: form of schizotomy involving fragmentation of the body, without any prior cephalization of the various frag- ments; compare with paratomy.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: article: demarcated sections of chaetae or cirri separated by joints.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: articulate: jointed, as in antennae, tentacular cirri, palps, and dorsal cirri.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: achaetigerous: see achaetous.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: atoke: non-sexual, unmodified pertaining state of an individual; that undergo to taxa epitoky.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: auricule: paired ear-shaped processes the base of at an antenna (ceratophore) characteristic of Sigalionidae. some

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: avicular: beaked; shaped like a bird’s head; used to describe hooked chaetae, uncini.

blocks.text: B

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: basal lappet: auricule. see

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: benthic: pertaining to the floor. sea

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: biarticulate: with two joints; pertaining to antennae, tentacular cirri, palps, and dorsal cirri.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: bidentate chaeta: distally. chacta with two teeth

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: bifid: distally split in two.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: bifurcate chaeta: simple chaeta with two prongs.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: bilimbate chaeta: simple chaeta with two wings; see limbate.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: biramous parapodium: parapodium with two branches, a notopodium and a neuropodium.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: blade: distal, flattened portion of compound simple a or chaeta.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: boss: small projection or knob-like process in compound and simple chaetae.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: brain: ganglionic mass situated at least in part in the prostomi- um.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: branchia, branchiae: of the body wall with extension a loop of the vascular usually well system; equipped with capillary blood-vessels.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: branchial crown: see radiolar crown.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: branchiferous: term referring to segments bearing branchiae.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: brush-tipped chaeta: simple chacta with brush-like (also a tip known penicillate chaeta). as

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: buccal cavity: mouth cavity.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: buccal organ: anterior part of alimentary canal derived from the larval stomodeum, comprising a complex set of folds, musculature, and glands; see pharynx.
